name: university transport
task: Write a practice paragraph about making university transport accessible.
essay: Our university need a better transport policy. Many students cannot afford a car; therefore affordable buses are essential. The library stays open late, for students need a quiet place to work. However convenient cars may be, they occupy valuable space.

corrections.explanation: The singular subject university takes needs.
The linking adverb therefore needs a following comma here.

name: museum email
task: Write a short email to a friend about a museum visit and your plans.
essay: I read the exhibition guide last night. Yesterday I went to the museum and buy a ticket. Tomorrow I am meeting the curator. I will call as soon as I know the details. This morning I have had a coffee.

corrections.explanation: Buying the ticket belongs to the same finished past event as went.

name: correct energy paragraph
task: Write a short practice paragraph discussing investment in clean energy.
essay: Solar panels can reduce emissions; however, their initial cost can be high. However difficult it seems, a gradual transition is possible. Cities should consult residents, for they know their neighbourhoods. I have known our local engineer since 2010. Investment does not mean that every existing system must be replaced immediately.

name: library services
task: Explain how public libraries support a community.
essay: A library offer useful services. It provides an useful resource for new residents; moreover it creates a place to meet. For example local groups can organise free classes. Nevertheless, these programmes require stable funding.

corrections.explanation: Useful begins with a consonant sound, so it takes a.
The linking adverb moreover takes a following comma here.
The introductory example marker is separated from the clause by a comma.
